s: Lomar mishnat bammeh madliqin ubo b' seipim: nohagim lomar pereq "bammeh madliqin", lepi sheyyesh bo din hadlaqa vehag' debarim shetztzarik lomar im chasheka. Vehasseparaddim omerim oto qodem tepillat arbit, kede sheal yede qeriat pereq zeh yizkor hag' debarim shetztzarik adam lomar veyazhir alehem, vegam kede sheyyedeu "bammeh madliqin ubammeh en madliqin", veyizzaharu laasot ken, abal achar tepillat arbit — mah toelet sheyyizkor? Halo en beyado letaqqen meatta. Abal bimdinot ellu en chosheshim lazeh, ella omerim oto achar hattepilla, kede shemmi sheechar labo lebet hakkeneset yesayyem tepillato beod shehatztzibbur omerim oto. Velaken en nohagin leomro beshabbat shel chol hammoed, sheaz en mitacharin kol kak, lepi sheen osim melaka kol kak. Vekol shekken beyom tob shechal lihyot beereb shabbat. Veken beyom tob shechal beshabbat en nohagin leomro, kede lemaher besimchat yom tob:
Bimqomot shemmeqaddeshim bebet hakkeneset yesh leqaddesh qodem amirat "bammeh madliqin", lepi sheyyesh lehaqdim qedushshat hayyom bekol mah sheepshar:
